speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You mention a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; to begin my evaluation, how long have you had these symptoms, and have you noticed any joint pain or fatigue?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) with possible neurological involvement. The combination of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), occupational exposure to liver-toxic substances (livestock/rice farm), and neuropathy is highly suggestive. REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (LFTs), Urine porphobilinogen/porphyrins, and Hepatitis C serology. REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatoscopy of the facial and upper body rash.
